research_question: Does preserving the local dialogue neighborhood around lexical retrieval anchors retain substantially more answer-bearing source text than three isolated turns, without exceeding half of the complete-session character budget?
hypothesis: Two lexical anchors plus each anchor's immediate predecessor and successor will retain answer-bearing turns in at least eight of ten fixed cases, improving by at least four cases over the frozen 4/10 isolated-turn control while keeping mean character ratios at or below 0.5.

independent_variable.name: source_projection_turn_selection
independent_variable.control: the three highest lexical-overlap non-empty turns, serialized as isolated source turns in original order
independent_variable.intervention: the two highest lexical-overlap non-empty anchor turns plus each anchor's immediate original predecessor and successor when non-empty, deduplicated and serialized in original order

adjacency_algorithm.query: official question reconstructed locally from the pinned dataset; not committed
adjacency_algorithm.anchor_score: unchanged V2.6 normalized lexical overlap between question tokens and one original turn
adjacency_algorithm.serialization: unchanged timestamp and original speaker-labelled source text in ascending original turn order

evidence_boundary: V2.7 compares one deterministic projection change on ten exposed LoCoMo single-hop development cases. A pass can authorize only a new preregistration on untouched reserve conversations; it cannot authorize model generation, runtime use, or production.
